title: Marketing Specialist, Oncology
description:
Role Summary
We’re looking for a generalist marketing specialist to lead marketing efforts for ConcertAI’s oncology solutions. This individual will own messaging, launch marketing, content creation, and growth campaigns for the products listed above, and with the use of AI tools and orchestration, execute campaigns to drive growth. This role will require basic technical knowledge about the biopharma product lifecycle. This is a perfect role for a new Master’s or Ph.D. graduate interested in exploring careers outside of the scientific domain, while still leveraging their technical skills.

Responsibilities
:
Campaign orchestration:
Design and run integrated, multi-channel campaigns that combine fuel (content, creative, messaging) with engine (distribution and channels).
AI-powered execution:
Use AI tools, workflows, and agents to extend capabilities, improve velocity, and scale output—while maintaining a high quality bar. Train and enable others to do the same.
Audience-first strategy:
Start with a deep understanding of our audience and market. Use insights (powered by AI + human research) to guide positioning, differentiation, messaging, and campaign priorities.
Cross-functional leadership:
Serve as the connector between product, sales, sales enablement, and leadership teams.
Focus on high-impact work:
Set a strategy and build a roadmap around high-impact programs and campaigns, not around isolated channels and a scattered content ideas.
Broad skillset across functions
: Demonstrated working knowledge and a strong sense of what great looks like across all areas of marketing
,
pulling in contractors, agencies, and AI agents and tools to help as needed.
Product marketing:
Refine messaging and positioning, communicate value clearly, and translate audience insights into differentiated campaigns
Growth & demand:
Launch and optimize campaigns across multiple channels, building automated and signal-based plays, centered around moving accounts
Content:
Own the narrative and “fuel” of the company. Produce and distribute content that engages prospects, customers, candidates, and partners
Launch marketing:
Own campaigns to bring new products and features to market
Tech stack & process:
Partner with others in our marketing team to influence creation of a modern, AI-first marketing stack. Evaluate, test, and scale tools, processes, and workflows that help the team move faster.

Requirements
Company Overview
ConcertAI is building the future of precision medicine. We use advanced artificial intelligence and real-world data to transform how healthcare and life sciences generate evidence, make decisions, and improve patient outcomes—starting in oncology and rapidly expanding across therapeutic areas. Our teams partner with the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies, providers, and research organizations to solve some of healthcare’s most complex challenges.
At the core of our innovation is CaraAI, our next-generation AI platform that unlocks powerful insights from complex clinical, imaging, and molecular data. Combined with our Precision Suite—which unifies real-world data, advanced analytics, and scalable evidence generation—these solutions are transforming how clinical development, regulatory, and commercialization decisions are made.
ConcertAI brings together a portfolio of purpose-built solutions, including TeraRecon, an industry leader in advanced imaging and AI-driven visualization, and CancerLinQ, the ASCO-originated oncology platform advancing care quality and large-scale discovery.
Joining ConcertAI means working alongside bold thinkers, builders, and healthcare experts on innovative, high-impact products that directly improve patient lives. You’ll be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization at the forefront of AI-enabled healthcare, with meaningful opportunities for growth and leadership.

title: Client Engagement Partner
description:
Role Summary
ConcertAI is seeking a Client Engagement Partner to serve as an embedded, on-site leader supporting a large pharmaceutical client’s Breast Cancer (BR CA) initiatives. This role is designed for a consultant-caliber, highly professional client partner—someone who can operate “toe-to-toe” with senior client stakeholders, shape and defend measurement strategy, and ensure the program is delivering value and credibility.
You will sit closely with the client’s Oncology team, act as the day-to-day face of ConcertAI, and translate analytics, measurement methodology, and program outcomes into clear business decisions and next steps.This position will be client facing with ~90% of time spent at the client site, remote days as needed. Travel may be required for periodic program reviews, leadership steering committees, and cross-site stakeholder meetings.

Responsibilities
On-site client engagement & program leadership
Serve as the embedded engagement lead on-site at least 4 days per week, maintaining strong day-to-day presence with the client’s Oncology team.
Drive regular program health check-ins and formal success reviews, including executive-ready readouts of progress, outcomes, and risks.
Establish trusted-advisor relationships with cross-functional client partners (brand/medical, commercial, analytics, market access, HEOR/RWE, and operations as applicable).
Measurement strategy, credibility, and consulting-grade problem solving
Lead client conversations on what we are measuring and why, ensuring the approach is fit-for-purpose, defensible, and aligned to business objectives.
Confidently challenge assumptions and refine measurement plans: identify what is “right vs. wrong,” what is missing, and how to improve validity and interpretability.
Partner with internal ConcertAI stakeholders (product, data science, analytics, clinical SMEs) to translate client needs into actionable analysis and deliverables.
Executive communication & stakeholder management
Own stakeholder mapping, meeting cadence, decision logs, and escalation management across both client and ConcertAI teams.
Create and deliver high-polish, consulting-style materials: steering committee decks, weekly summaries, program KPI scorecards, and impact narratives.
Anticipate client concerns and proactively manage expectations, timelines, and risks.
Value delivery & account growth support
Identify opportunities to expand scope by connecting outcomes to adjacent needs (new measures, new populations, new workflows) while maintaining delivery excellence.
Ensure the engagement is operationally strong: clear requirements, well-managed delivery, and measurable client value.

title: Vice President, International Sales, Imaging Solutions
description:
Role Summary
The Vice President of International Sales is a strategic commercial leader responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding market presence, and strengthening customer relationships across the United Kingdom, Germany, Italy, and Japan. This role oversees a distributed, multi-disciplinary regional team to ensure seamless end-to-end customer lifecycle management from initial engagement through post-sales adoption, clinical customer success, and customer satisfaction.
In this capacity, you will develop regional go-to-market strategies, cultivate high-value enterprise partnerships, consistently deliver against revenue targets, and serve as an ambassador for ConcertAI’s Imaging Solutions product vision in key global markets. The ideal candidate brings deep healthcare provider or medical imaging domain experience, strong people leadership capability, and a track record of building high performing international sales organizations.

Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership & Strategy
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with growth objectives for key global markets.
Build market-specific plans for UK, Germany, Italy, and Japan, accounting for regional regulations, reimbursement environments, competitive dynamics, and customer needs.
Own regional revenue targets, forecasting, NPS, and pipeline development across all product lines.
Represent ConcertAI’s Imaging Solutions in strategic partner discussions, channel relationships, and executive-level customer and industry engagements.
Team Leadership & Performance Management
Lead, coach, and develop a multi-country organization including Directors of Sales, junior sellers, clinical specialists, and support staff.
Create a high-performing culture that emphasizes accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Drive hiring, onboarding, and talent development for all regional sales and clinical positions.
Ensure cross-functional alignment with Marketing, Product, Clinical, Implementation, Finance, and Customer Success teams.
Customer Engagement & Lifecycle Ownership
Oversee all aspects of customer engagement from pre-sales discovery through post-sales implementation, adoption, renewals, and expansion.
Partner with clinical and technical customer success teams to ensure world-class customer experience and proactive account management.
Develop deep relationships with strategic hospital systems, imaging centers, academic institutions, national healthcare entities, and channel partners.
Drive retention, upsell, and cross-sell Imaging and AI portfolio across the Healthcare Enterprise.
Operational Excellence
Establish and optimize regional sales processes, forecasting discipline, Objective/KeyResults, and business metrics reporting.
Ensure compliance with corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and data privacy standards across all regions.
Provide market intelligence to inform product roadmap, pricing strategies, and competitive positioning.
Ensure customer success and achieve retention goals.

Joining ConcertAI means becoming part of a visionary team dedicated to transforming the healthcare landscape. You'll have the opportunity to work on innovative projects that directly impact patient lives, collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry, and be at the cutting edge of technological advancements in healthcare. title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Responsibilities
Systems Administration:
Own, maintain, and administrate the ConcertAI’s budgeting and forecasting system – Workday Adaptive Planning. Develop and enhance the company’s Adaptive budget and forecast models and associated connections to NetSuite ERP and OfficeConnect enabled reporting.  Manage and be the main contact with external resources for improving the company’s budget models and Adaptive dashboards. Ensure projects are completed on time, achieve the targeted outcome and are within budget.
Financial Reporting and Presentations for Consolidated AI:
Prepare accurate and insightful financial reports, presentations, and dashboards for senior management and other stakeholders. Present complex financial information in a clear and concise manner to facilitate data-driven decision-making.
Manage the consolidation of financials and other summary reports for monthly business reviews (MBR’s), budget, forecasts and three-year plans. Ensure timeliness and accuracy are met.

Partner with corporate functions such as IT, HR, Legal, Accounting, Marketing, Facilities, etc. to provide monthly reporting with financial insights and support for strategic initiatives, and capital investments. Work cross-functionally with Finance, Accounting, Sales Operations, Product Management, Operations, and senior management to synthesize information, gain alignment, and stay up to date on emerging trends and developments.

Collaborate with Human Resources to own and maintain the company’s current and new hire employee roster to ensure labor cost forecasting is accurate and complete. Must maintain high degree of confidentiality when working with sensitive compensation information.

Stay updated with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in financial analysis systems and reporting. Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

Company Overview
ConcertAI is building the future of precision medicine. We use advanced artificial intelligence and real-world data to transform how healthcare and life sciences generate evidence, make decisions, and improve patient outcomes—starting in oncology and rapidly expanding across therapeutic areas. Our teams partner with the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies, providers, and research organizations to solve some of healthcare’s most complex challenges.
At the core of our innovation is CaraAI, our next-generation AI platform that unlocks powerful insights from complex clinical, imaging, and molecular data. Combined with our Precision Suite—which unifies real-world data, advanced analytics, and scalable evidence generation—these solutions are transforming how clinical development, regulatory, and commercialization decisions are made.
ConcertAI brings together a portfolio of purpose-built solutions, including TeraRecon, an industry leader in advanced imaging and AI-driven visualization, and CancerLinQ, the ASCO-originated oncology platform advancing care quality and large-scale discovery.
Joining ConcertAI means working alongside bold thinkers, builders, and healthcare experts on innovative, high-impact products that directly improve patient lives. You’ll be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization at the forefront of AI-enabled healthcare, with meaningful opportunities for growth and leadership.
